title: Very glad we bought it at the time
text:
Very glad we bought it at the time. I wasn't really sure what to expect with this little heater.
We have an upstairs bedroom in a rental place (where we can't do major changes), and it
is very chilly in the winter. Add wind, and it gets freaky cold inside! We've actually had
ice on the closet walls before.

So, I wanted to get a small space heater that wouldn't require us running the central heat
if only our bedroom was cold.

This little guy does the job very well.
I don't find the noise annoying - it is like a computer running, with slight magnification.
It is not as noisy as a fan. I don't mind it a bit, and it can be like white noise, blocking
out other small annoyances.

This is so completely adjustable, it makes it great.
I've used both the high and low power settings, and don't see a huge difference between them.
I guess the high technically heats up faster, but again, I didn't really notice.
The other dial is how warm you want the air to be that comes out.
I've used it on many of the settings so far. Yesterday, for example, had 30-40 mph winds here
and it was very cold in the bedroom - cold enough I had a hard time sewing something by hand!
I put the little heater aimed at my desk, and within 1/2 hr, the room was very comfortable.
The room is about 12' x 10'. By the time my daughter got home from school, it was too hot,
and we had to turn it off for a while!

All in all, I'm very happy with it. We bought two different kinds, one for downstairs and one
for upstairs, to try to cut back on our utility bill. The other brand works just fine too, but
I think this one is a little better! : )

All in all, I would definitely recommend it. It won't heat a 2-story house, but it does 2 or 3 rooms
to a pleasant temperature (I don't like it super hot anyway, but it gets to 72 pretty easily) very well.
Upstairs, we have two bedrooms and a small bathroom. I can put this in the hallway, and, although it
takes a little longer, will have the upstairs comfortably warm in an hour or so. The bedroom alone
with the heater in the room takes much less time. I've even had it near the desk when my hands
were freezing while typing!

Not sure how great the fan alone will be - I'll try that when it gets stuffy some day.
But I bought it for heating, and it does exactly what it says, and does it well.
Very pleased with the purchase.

=============================================================
UPDATE:

Well, we had our first problem with the heater today!
We have used it probably ten times this winter, and it has done a wonderful job of warming
the bedroom/hall area. HOWEVER - today, March 29, we went to unplug the heater and box it
back up for next winter's use. This is where the problem began!

I tried to unplug the heater, and couldn't do it! I tried and failed, tried the other hand and failed.
When my son got home, had HIM try and he failed! It took the two of us to get the heater disconnected
from the plug, and when we finally did, the prongs came out of the plug!! OMG.
Well, THAT was an interesting development!

I checked on the website, and the heater has a one-year warranty on parts. So, I contacted
Lasko via their customer care center, and we'll see what they will do about it!
I could hardly believe it! We've had it plugged in since December, so around three months,
but I really don't think that's long enough to create a stuck plug problem!
I'll update about how Lasko customer service is once I hear back, and we find a resolution to the problem.

Until then - unplug carefully! You can see the glue on the end of the plug on ours!

UPDATE:
No response from Lasko yet, so it is looking like I'll be buying another brand
of small space heater for next winter. What a shame. I really did like this one.
My husband has another brand, however, that did equally well at heating the room.
Lasko isn't the only player in the game at this point. Disappointing on the customer service
oversight. I've had it too long to ask Amazon to handle the problem - it isn't their fault
the plug was faulty - but sure wish I could send it back for a replacement!
I am dinging it one star both because of the plug, and because of the lack of support over
a product that was only a few months old and allegedly still under warranty.

UPDATE OCT 2013:
Here it is, late 2013, and Lasko never bothered to respond to our concerns.
The heater has been sitting in the hallway since the plug pulled out several months ago.
Now that winter is getting closer again, I am back on Amazon, looking for another heater.
It will NOT be this one - it worked like a champ, UNTIL we needed to unplug it!
Note that it is STILL UNDER WARRANTY, and they won't respond to the problem.

What the worst part was was Lasko ignoring our request entirely. No replacement heater,
replacement cord, credit towards another one, nothing at all.
So, we will be looking at other brands. Most have similar wattages now, so there is no
reason to be brand loyal, when they didn't care a bit about us.

product_metadata.title: Lasko Ceramic Adjustable Thermostat Space Heaters, Non-Oscillating, 754200 Silver
features: 3 Quiet Settings - including high heat, low heat, and fan only make this electric space heater ideal for warming up an area in your home. Combined with an adjustable thermostat this personal space heater is great for small areas. The product does not have a remote

Adjustable Thermostat - allows you to adjust the heater's 1500 watt ceramic heating element. With 11 different temperature settings you're sure to find a comfortable setting. Simply turn the dial to the heat setting you desire and enjoy comforting warmth.

Convenient Carry Handle - makes it easy to move the space heater. Thanks to the heater's compact size and convenient carry handle you can easily move the heater from the kitchen, to the bedroom, or even under the desk. Heating coverage: 300 Sq. ft

Built-in Safety Features - overheat protection ensures the space heater does not overheat even if left on for an extended amount of time. The space heater also features a cool-touch exterior. This allows the the space heater's body to stay cool even when it's on high.

Fully Assembled - allows you to take the heater out of the box and have it working in minutes. Simply plug the heater into a wall outlet, select your desired heat and thermostat settings, and enjoy the warmth from your new Lasko space heater.
Power source type: Corded Electric . Voltage: 110 Volts . Top-mounted manual controls
description: This compact space heater from Lasko brings 1500 watts of comforting warmth to your room. A classic design in silver with easy-to-use manual controls and built-in safety features, plus adjustable thermostat for personalized comfort. Features 3 quiet settings: high and low heat settings, as well as a fan-only setting so you can choose how much heat you want. Ceramic heat adds quick warmth with fan-powered delivery. This electric space heater is easily portable and comes with built-in safety features. This tabletop heater is perfect for the bedroom, living room, home office and more. ETL Listed.
